# fluent_2_flutter

> Microsoft Fluent 2 Design System for Flutter (iOS/Android)

## Overview
`fluent_2_flutter` implements Microsoft's Fluent 2 design system for Flutter mobile applications, strictly matching Microsoft's Fluent 2 specs while honoring native FluentMaterial API parameter naming habits.

## Documentation
- [COMPONENTS.md](COMPONENTS.md): Full component catalog with API parameter signatures and code examples.
- [doc/LLM_CONTEXT.md](doc/LLM_CONTEXT.md): Compact LLM usage context file for consuming apps.
- [packed_sources/PORTING_MAP_AND_TODO.md](packed_sources/PORTING_MAP_AND_TODO.md): Source file mapping table and porting status.

## Core Exports
- Theme: `FluentTheme`, `FluentThemeData`, `FluentColors`, `FluentGlobalTokens`, `FluentAliasTokens`, `ControlTokens`
- Buttons: `FluentButton`, `FluentCompoundButton`, `FluentFloatingActionButton`, `FluentChip`
- Inputs: `FluentSearchBar`, `FluentTextField`, `FluentPeoplePicker`
- Navigation: `FluentTopAppBar`, `FluentContextualCommandBar`, `FluentTabBar`, `FluentPillBar`
- Menus: `FluentPopupMenu`, `FluentPopupMenuButton`, `FluentMenu`, `showFluentPopupMenu`
- Dialogs & Sheets: `FluentDialog`, `FluentBottomSheet`, `FluentDrawer`, `showFluentDialog`, `showFluentBottomSheet`, `showFluentDrawer`
- Cards & Lists: `FluentListItem`, `FluentListSubHeader`, `FluentDivider`
- Notifications: `FluentSnackbar`, `FluentBanner`, `showFluentSnackbar`
- Personas & Avatars: `FluentAvatar`, `FluentAvatarGroup`, `FluentPersona`
- Progress & Transients: `FluentCircularProgressIndicator`, `FluentLinearProgressIndicator`, `FluentShimmer`, `FluentTooltip`
- Calendar: `FluentCalendarView`
- Icons: `FluentIcons`, `FluentIconData`
